_readme: Built-in op-amp library shipped with FilterSynthesizer. Plain JSON, hand-editable.
Each key under 'opamps' is the name shown in the Op-amp dropdown; names must be unique (case-insensitive).
Required: A_ol [V/V, open-loop DC gain], GBWP_hz [Hz, gain-bandwidth product], Ro_ohm [ohm, open-loop output resistance].
Optional: description [text], spice_model [model name only, for SPICE export], en_nV_rtHz [input voltage noise, nV/sqrt(Hz)], in_pA_rtHz [input current noise, pA/sqrt(Hz)]. Use null when unknown.
Your own parts and edits made in the app go to opamp_library_user.json in the per-user app-data folder, which overrides entries here by name and survives upgrades.
Values are typical datasheet figures; check the datasheet for your supply and load.
